text: RESOLVED: no Scope capability. Kernel binary ops stay Either-only as the primitive. Ergonomics come from a checked CONTAINER at the session layer: Session/Project validates frame membership on insertion (Either there), and its accessors are total because membership was proven on the way in. Rationale: a Scope capability is forgeable -- one obtained for frame A can be applied to objects from frame B, the exact bug class the design exists to stop. This is parse-don't-validate applied to the frame relation itself, and it doubles as the project object the app needs for APP-13. Affects k-framecheck, x-trials, app-prereq.
